clarifications.team_outlet: definitions.hand_team_acc: the outlet = the basin cell (centre) nearest the team's Nakkhu_Outlet point; its routing elevation is set 1 m below the basin minimum before fill / breach so the clipped basin drains (and its flats resolve) to it, as ArcGIS lets the outlet drain off the raster; its HAND reference is restored like a burned cell. Without it pysheds left the int16 outlet flats unresolved (8 % of Dem12.5 basin cells never reached a stream).
